summary: Cresud Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the upcoming interest payment on its Series LI fixed-rate notes due 2027. The filing is a routine payment notification: on July 20, 2026, the company will pay the first installment of interest at 5.75% p.a. on USD 46,778,518 outstanding principal, totaling USD 1,333,828.56, to noteholders of record on July 17, 2026. No special situation—acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or corporate event—is disclosed. This is a standard debt-service communication, not a special situation filing.
